note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Israel: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: Income from personal exertion is taxed on annual brackets for 2026 of 10% to ILS 84,120, 14% to 120,720, 20% to 228,000, 31% to 301,200, 35% to 560,280, 47% to 721,560 and 50% above (47% plus the 3% surtax); a resident's tax is reduced by credit points (2.25 for every resident, worth ILS 242 a month each in 2026); there is no local income tax.
figures.applies: Tax year 2026; residents on worldwide income, non-residents on Israeli-source income at the same rates

sources.said: Additionally, a 3% surtax applies on annual taxable income exceeding ILS 721,560, resulting in a 50% maximum income tax rate. Non-residents are taxed at the same rates as Israeli residents.
There are no local taxes on income in Israel.
‫זיכוי‬ ‫נקודת‬ ‫שווי‬ ₪242

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year; a required return is due by 30 April of the next year; employees whose tax is fully withheld generally need not file below set thresholds (wages under ILS 723,000 in 2025).

sources.said: Tax returns are filed on a calendar-year basis.
Should a tax return be required, 30 April is the prescribed filing due date, subject to extensions.

figures.finding: A resident employee pays national insurance of 1.04% on monthly pay up to ILS 7,703 and 7% above, to a ceiling of ILS 51,910, plus health tax of 3.23% and 5.17% on the same bands; the employer pays 4.51% and 7.6%; a non-resident employee pays 0.1% and 0.87% (employer 0.75% and 2.65%) and no health tax; a self-employed person aged 18 to pension age pays 4.47% national insurance plus 3.23% health tax (7.7%) on monthly income up to ILS 7,703 and 12.83% plus 5.17% (18%) above it to ILS 51,910.

sources.said: על הכנסה חודשית 7,703 ש"ח - (שיעור מופחת) … על הכנסה חודשית מעל 7,703 ש"ח ועד ההכנסה המרבית החייבת בדמי ביטוח בסך 51,910 ש"ח לחודש - (שיעור רגיל) דמי ביטוח לאומי 4.47% … 12.83% דמי ביטוח בריאות 3.23% 5.17% סך הכול 7.7% 18%

Employees’ national insurance contribution for non-resident employees is 0.1% on the first ILS 7,703 of income per month and 0.87% on the difference between ILS 7,703 and the maximum monthly compensation amount of ILS 51,910. Employers' national insurance contribution for non-resident employees is 0.75% on the first ILS 7,703 of income per month and 2.65% on the difference between ILS 7,703 and the maximum monthly compensation amount of ILS 51,910.

figures.finding: Income tax and social contributions are withheld from all pay by statute, whoever the employer, and remitted on the 15th of the next month; the self-employed pay monthly or bimonthly advances, usually a percentage of turnover.

value.selfEmployed: monthly or bimonthly advances on turnover

sources.said: Payroll withholding of income and social tax is statutory, irrespective of the residence of the employer or employee.
Self-employed individuals are generally required to make monthly or bimonthly advance tax payments, usually based on a percentage of turnover.

figures.finding: A non-resident performer, writer or director is taxed on Israeli-source income; the payer must withhold 25% (25 agorot per shekel) from income paid to a non-resident individual (23%, the corporate rate, to a company), unless the Tax Authority certifies an exemption or a treaty rate; whether the withholding is final was not found.

sources.said: כל המשלם לאדם שאינו תושב ישראל, לו או לאחר בשבילו, כל הכנסה חייבת לפי פקודה זו, שאינה הכנסה שממנה נוכה מס לפי הסעיפים 161 ו-164 חייב לנכות מאותה הכנסה, בעת תשלומה, מס של 25 אגורות לכל שקל אם מקבל התשלום הוא יחיד, ומס בשיעור המוטל לפי הסעיפים 126 ו-127 אם מקבל התשלום הוא חבר-בני-אדם

Under Israeli domestic tax law, WHT on payments of Israeli-source income is generally deducted at the corporate tax rate from all income remittances abroad, unless a tax certificate is obtained from the ITA authorising withholding-exempt remittances or a reduced rate of tax pursuant to an applicable tax treaty.
Non-resident corporations: Non-treaty 25/30 (2) 23 23

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a non-resident are withheld at 23% (treaty rates often 0 to 10%); a resident's passive royalties count toward the 2% capital-income surtax above ILS 721,560; no special regime for authors' earned royalties was found.

sources.said: Non-resident corporations: Non-treaty 25/30 (2) 23 23

the portion of an individual's annual income from capital sources (e.g. capital gains, real estate appreciation, dividends, interest, CPI linkage differentials, rental income, passive royalties) exceeding a certain threshold (ILS 721,560 in 2026) is subject to an additional surtax of 2%.

figures.finding: VAT is 18%; a freelancer whose annual turnover stays under ILS 122,833 in 2026 (set yearly by the Tax Authority) may be an exempt dealer (osek patur) and charges no VAT.
figures.applies: Supplies in Israel; the 2026 ceiling is from a secondary source, as gov.il refuses this environment; some liberal professions must register whatever their turnover (not read for performers).

sources.said: The current rate of VAT is 18%.
תקרת ההכנסות נקבעת מדי שנה על ידי רשות המסים.
